findings.text: Reconnects reset the heartbeat deadline: connections recycled within 240 seconds can keep delivering indefinitely without refreshing presence, while the monitor stays on standby. Reproduction using the actual presenceBeat/startHeartbeat in memory: twelve 40 ms connections with a 100 ms interval produced posts=0; an uninterrupted 140 ms connection produced posts=1. Preserve the heartbeat deadline across reconnects, retain the liveness guard, and add a regression test.

Acceptance 4 does not test continued delivery: its fake returns 404 for /api/me, so the monitor cannot start its feed. Reproduction: an in-memory mutation replacing await feed.start() with await Promise.resolve() still passed every acceptance-4 assertion; output was sessionPosts=4, deliveredBytes=0. Use a functioning feed with only /api/sessions returning 500, inject an eligible message, and assert delivery during repeated heartbeat failures.
